thread:
Anika: FYI I ran into a shape mismatch in the node sampleapp when using the embedding/rerank batching helper.
Anika: Sending a small batch with one request that has a single candidate causes the helper to send candidate embeddings as a flat array, runtime returns "vectors length mismatch". Python SDK doesn't trigger it.
Chris: Can you show the failing request body?
Anika: gist-redacted: {"model":"rerank-open-1","queries":["q1"],"candidates":["only"],"embeddings":{"queries":[[0.12,0.34]],"candidates": [0.45,0.67]}}
Anika: Notice candidates embeddings are flat instead of [[...]]
Maria: Ah the helper has a fastpath that normalizes single-candidate lists into a scalar/1D array.
Sam: That would break the runtime check which expects candidates.length == candidate_embeddings.length.
Chris: Any retries/auth refreshes in the trace? Those can re-pack batches and expose shape issues.
Anika: Yes there was a token refresh retry right before the second attempt. It retried the batched payload and the fastpath kicked in on repackage.
Leo: Minimal repro: three small requests, one with single candidate, enable debug logs. I can add an e2e test.
Chris: I'll add a sanitizer in the node helper to ensure embeddings fields are always array-of-arrays. Also add a unit test that simulates a 401 refresh + retry to ensure repack is stable.
Maria: I'll update the sampleapp README note about this gotcha and file an SDK docs ticket.
devex-bot: PR created: pr/5248 
Includes node helper validator + tests. :rocket:
Anika: Thanks all, will validate against our staging workload after the patch. :thumbsup:
